help.title: Help Center
help.contactSub: Our team is ready to assist you through the following channels.

faqs.question: How do I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: Go to the Booking menu, select a table on the map, then tap the Book Now button.

faqs.question: What is RFID and how do I use it?
faqs.answer: RFID is used to check in at your table. Tap your RFID card on the available sensor.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can cancel your reservation before check-in time through the Booking menu.

faqs.question: Why can't I select a table?
faqs.answer: The table may be full or currently being cleaned. Please try selecting another table.
